_comment: Pay-per-event pricing applied via the Apify API by ops/publish.mjs. 'watch-run' covers compute on runs that find nothing new (Apify zeroes profit for months where price does not cover usage).

watch-run.eventDescription: Charged once per run: checks all selected portals and updates your watch.

notice.eventDescription: Charged once per new or changed tender notice delivered to your dataset. Unchanged notices are not returned or charged.
